name: app-6a978de94ee481919bd162fe89e0e274
description: Search your MSP's phone calls and PSA tickets in Vight and read call transcripts, summaries, ticket notes, time entries and resolutions.

interface.longDescription:
Vight connects to the phone system you already use (RingCentral, 3CX, Microsoft Teams, Intermedia and more) and automatically transcribes and summarizes every call. Those calls are linked to the right ticket and client in your PSA, so nothing sits disconnected in a call log no one opens again.

With the Vight plugin, ChatGPT can search your calls and your ConnectWise, HaloPSA or Autotask tickets from a single question. Ask what was said on last week's call with a client, what a ticket's notes and time entries say, or how a similar issue was resolved before, and Vight returns the answer with a link back to the call or ticket so you can verify it.

Built for MSPs and IT service teams who need fast, accurate answers without re-opening every system. Resolve tickets faster with full call context on hand, and onboard new technicians with instant access to how past issues were handled.

The plugin is read-only and uses the same access you have in Vight: you only see the calls and tickets your Vight account can see. Sign in with the Microsoft or Google work account you use for Vight.
capabilities: Search call transcripts by content, date or client
Search PSA tickets by title, notes, time entries or resolution
Read a call's summary, participants and transcript
Read a ticket's header, description, notes and time entries
defaultPrompt: What did we tell Acme about their firewall on last week's calls?
How have we resolved Outlook sync issues in past tickets?
Summarize this week's open tickets for Contoso

positive.description: Search calls by topic and client over a date range
positive.prompt: Find calls from the last two weeks where a client asked about replacing their firewall.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with type 'calls', a topic query and a startTime about two weeks ago, then lists the matching calls with their dates, clients and short excerpts, each linked to the call in Vight.

positive.description: Read a call transcript after searching
positive.prompt: Find the most recent call about a printer outage and tell me what the technician promised the caller.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search for printer outage calls, then fetch with the id of the most recent result, and answers from that call's summary and transcript, citing the call link.

positive.description: Search tickets for how an issue was resolved
positive.prompt: How have we fixed Outlook not syncing in past tickets?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with type 'tickets' and a query about Outlook sync, fetches one or more closed tickets, and summarizes the resolutions found in their notes and time entries with links to each ticket.

positive.prompt: Which open tickets mention VPN connection drops?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with type 'tickets', status 'open' and a VPN query, and lists the open tickets returned with their numbers, titles and links.

positive.description: Combine calls and tickets for one client
positive.prompt: Catch me up on everything we've discussed or logged about email migration for our clients this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with type 'all' and a startTime at the start of the month, fetches the most relevant call and ticket results, and gives a combined summary that cites each call and ticket it used.

negative.description: General IT question unrelated to the member's data
negative.prompt: What is the difference between TCP and UDP?

negative.description: Request to change data in the PSA
negative.prompt: Close ticket 48213 and add a note saying the issue is resolved.
Write me a birthday poem for my sister.

review.commerce_description: Vight does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search Vight calls and PSA tickets, and read call summaries, transcripts, ticket notes, time entries and resolutions.
